relationships.subject: microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Among Ki67+ microglia, ~ 70% were GFP+ in the cortex and hippocampus of CB2-KO-eGFP, compared with 10-15% in WT mice

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: However, compared to WT mice, CB2-KO-eGFP mice exhibited significantly attenuated responses to Δ9-THC across all three measurements

relationships.subject: neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, these results indicate that both glial cells and neurons express CB2R under physiological conditions.

key_findings: A new CB2-KO-eGFP knock-in reporter line shows CB2R promoter-driven GFP in ~70% of microglia and ~4% of neurons in cortex and hippocampus, plus astrocytes, in healthy brain.
CB2R deletion attenuated THC-induced analgesia, hypothermia and catalepsy.
